label: Investigate
description: Read-only root-cause diagnosis: gather evidence, synthesize a cited conclusion, report or file an issue. Never modifies the repo. If you decide to use sub agents, always set openai-oauth/gpt-5.5 · effort: low.
when_to_use: Use when the task is to understand or diagnose something — a bug's root cause, an architecture question, unexpected behaviour — with NO changes made. Do NOT use when a PR exists to review ('adversarial-review') or when the task is to implement a fix ('bugfix', 'feature').

guards.message: This workflow is READ-ONLY: diagnose and report, never change the repo. If a fix is wanted, start a 'bugfix' or 'feature' workflow afterwards.

steps.label: State the question and what would answer it
steps.guidance: Write down the precise question being investigated and what evidence would settle it (a log line, a code path, a failing command). Note the boundaries: which repos/subsystems are in scope. Done when the question and its answer-criteria are written down.

steps.label: Gather evidence (parallel read-only where useful)
steps.guidance: Collect concrete evidence: read the code paths, run read-only commands, reproduce observations. For separable angles, spawn parallel read-only investigator subagents (read_only: true), one angle each, requiring file:line citations. Distinguish observed facts from inference at every step. Done when each answer-criterion from scope has supporting or refuting evidence.

steps.label: Synthesize the root cause / answer
steps.guidance: State the conclusion with its evidence chain (every claim cites file:line or a command output). Actively try to refute your own conclusion once: name the strongest alternative explanation and why the evidence rules it out — if it doesn't, say so and mark the conclusion as tentative. Done when the conclusion and its confidence level are written down.

steps.label: Report findings and clean up
steps.guidance: Deliver the diagnosis: question, conclusion, evidence, confidence, and recommended next action (e.g. file a gh issue with the evidence, or start a 'bugfix' workflow). Terminate any straggler subagents (get_subagents) and confirm `git status` is clean. Done when the report is delivered and nothing was modified.
